novelty_check.method: public catalogue search (Hugging Face datasets, Zenodo, arXiv) plus web search for an existing ML-ready formulation of this exact task
novelty_check.ours: per-plan-year binary funding-coverage task at the plan-launch instant with launch-vintage (original) requirements denominators, temporal splits over 782 plan-years 2000-2025, dated label provenance from the publisher's own API, the measured vintage-trap evidence (54% of plans revised post-launch; today's bulk CSV carries revised values), and a persistence-referenced scored contract

novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
novelty_check.theirs: OCHA FTS/HDX/HAPI publish the raw requirements-and-funding tables (and HF user accounts mirror the same per-country CSVs); the GHO reports after-the-fact coverage aggregates; academic aid-allocation studies run panel regressions on similar data - none ship an ML-ready task with a prediction instant, splits and a scored contract

prediction_question: For a UN-coordinated humanitarian appeal or response plan (HRP/CAP/flash appeal/HNRP/SRP and similar single-country plans) at its public launch instant (requirements first published - GHO early December for the following year, or the plan's own release, whichever the record dates), will the plan receive funding equal to at least 50% of its ORIGINAL (launch-vintage) requirements by the close of its plan year? Features are launch-time attributes (original requirements, plan type, GHO membership, country/region, emergency linkage) plus strictly-prior-year history for the same country (prior-year plan coverage, funding levels, series length). A useful prediction identifies, months ahead, which appeals will end the year underfunded - the quantity GHO gap analysis reports after the fact - enabling donor advocacy and fundraising prioritization.
prediction_time: The plan's public launch: the instant its requirements are first published (GHO publication in early December for the following plan year, or the plan's own release for late-launched plans). Dated example (all UTC): Afghanistan HRP 2023 (plan id 1117) - GHO 2023 launched 2022-12-01 with Afghanistan at $4.6B; the HRP itself launched end of December 2022 / early January 2023; prediction instant pinned at 2023-01-01T00:00Z. Every feature is fixed by that instant: original requirements (plan endpoint origRequirements = 4,627,363,573, matching the December 2022 GHO ask), plan type, country, and strictly-prior plan-years (all closed years, final values). The target window is the plan year 2023-01-01..2023-12-31, strictly after the instant. VINTAGE POLICY (the decisive timing finding): the HDX CSV 'requirements' column is CURRENT-vintage - of 836 plans with requirements, 286 were revised up and 166 down after launch, and the CSV shows the revised value in revised cases - so it must never be used as a launch feature; the plan endpoint's origRequirements is the launch-vintage denominator, verified against the December 2022 GHO on the Afghanistan fixture. Prior-year funding totals used as features are current-vintage final values for closed years, approximating what was knowable at launch (late-reported flows are the measured gap - flow records carry firstReportedDate and decisionDate; 94.5% decisionDate coverage in a 200-flow sample); this retrospective approximation is declared as the restricted protocol and probed at gate 1.5, not assumed to be operational forecasting.

review: All five discovery contracts reconciled against recorded evidence (2026-10-29). (1) Redistribution: SUPPORTED - the dataset's own page grants use/republish with citation (quote in license_evidence), and the publisher's HDX distribution of the same data is CC BY-IGO; licence_class A; attribution and no-endorsement conditions carry into LICENSE.md. (2) Prediction timing: SUPPORTED with a declared restricted retrospective protocol - launch instant dated and verified on the Afghanistan fixture (GHO 2022-12-01 ask == origRequirements to 3 significant figures); the decisive vintage finding is measured (54% of plans revised post-launch; HDX CSV column carries revised values; the flip demonstrator is recorded); construction uses origRequirements only; prior-year features are current-vintage finals for closed years with the late-reporting gap measured on flows (firstReportedDate lags decisionDate; 94.5% decisionDate coverage); gate-1.5 reverse-history probes on the exact artifact are mandatory in the handoff - the label is a later aggregation of the same stream, so the retrospective posture must be declared, exactly as on unhcr/abs. (3) Obtainable target: SUPPORTED - per-plan-year funding totals from the publisher's API, equal to its own HDX distribution on measured single-country fixtures; label source columns excludable; censoring rule and zero-funding rows pinned; regional-plan slices excluded with the measured 0.78 gap. (4) Split capacity: SUPPORTED by full-population measurement - 782 primary plan-years, three disjoint windows with both classes (table in split_strategy), clustered count recorded (83 country series; year-clustered prevalence drift 68%->43% is a measured phenomenon property, not a defect). (5) Contribution beyond a mirror: SUPPORTED - novelty verdict differentiated (recorded by check-novelty): the publisher and third parties distribute the raw requirements/funding tables (HDX, HAPI, HF per-country mirrors), but no ML-ready per-plan-year coverage task with an instant, splits and a scored contract exists; our contribution is the launch-vintage-denominator formulation, the vintage trap evidence, the dated fixture set and the persistence-referenced evaluation. Residual uncertainties, stated: (a) the WB instrument-outcome drops (identity-dominated, no headroom over persistence) are the named risk for this family - the prior-year same-country coverage rule is the primary reference and decides whether headroom stands; (b) origRequirements is verified launch-vintage on one external December source (Afghanistan 2023) plus internal orig/revised separation on 836 plans - construction asserts the GHO cross-check on sampled cohorts; (c) the ~6% of flows lacking decisionDate only affects the optional within-year trajectory variant, not the primary launch-instant formulation; (d) exact per-window counts on final construction data may shift slightly when empty-funding rows are pinned.

split_strategy: Temporal, on the primary population (782 single-country plan-years with origRequirements>0, 2000-2025), measured from the source on 2026-10-29 at the >=50%-of-ORIGINAL-requirements threshold: train 2000-2016: 437 rows, pos 282 / neg 155 (64.5%), 78 distinct countries; eval 2017-2020: 139 rows, pos 81 / neg 58 (58.3%), 51 countries; holdout 2021-2025: 182 rows, pos 96 / neg 86 (52.7%), 43 countries. Both classes present in every window. 2026 live-edge rows (24) excluded until their year closes. CLUSTERED COUNT (the honest sample size): 83 distinct country series in the primary population, max 28 plan-years for one country; positives also cluster by year through global funding cycles - measured positive rate at the 50% threshold drifts 68.3% (2000-2013) -> 52.3% (2014-2018) -> 63.8% (2019-2022) -> 42.5% (2023-2025), and GHO coverage fell from ~50% (2022) to 38% (2023) per the publisher's own snapshot; intervals and baselines must be country-clustered and year-aware. The final window cut is construction's choice; these three windows are the measured default.
target_definition: Binary: the plan's FTS funding total for its plan year (usage year = plan year; commitments + paid contributions, pledges excluded, USD, publisher's own attribution including boundary flows) divided by its ORIGINAL requirements (launch vintage) is >= 0.50 -> 1, else 0. Label source: per-plan-year funding totals (FTS flow endpoint incoming.fundingTotal with planId+year filter; equal to the publisher's HDX distribution on single-country rows - measured: Yemen HRP 2023 1,774,327,599, Afghanistan HRP 2023 1,678,347,238, both API==CSV to the dollar) and origRequirements from the plan endpoint; both excludable from features by construction (features carry launch attributes and strictly-prior years only). Censoring: plan-years whose year has not closed are excluded and counted (2026 live edge: 24 primary rows), never imputed. Zero-funding rows are the publisher's recorded outcome (empty funding fields in the HDX CSV counted at construction, not dropped silently). Population: PRIMARY = single-country plan-years with origRequirements > 0, 2000-2025 (782 rows; 60 multi-country regional plans excluded from the primary task because the HDX CSV splits them into country slices whose funding sum covers only ~78% of the plan total - measured on Burundi RRP 2021: slices 14,978,233 vs API plan total 19,282,778; regional plans can be a secondary population with flow-endpoint totals if construction wants them). Appeal-linked funding only; the country rows without plan linkage (2,678 HDX CSV rows, 'Not specified' plans) are outside the task population, so the label's meaning is single-population throughout.
